name: Eden
description: Adam and Eve's garden, the newly created World's crown -- Genesis 2 supplies the bare fact of its existence and the forbidden tree; Milton supplies its extensive sensory description, guarded perimeter, and daily routine, virtually all Miltonic invention. Guarded by Gabriel's angelic watch after Satan's first intrusion (Book IV).
power_structure: Adam and Eve, under God's single prohibition (the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil)
story_hooks: Satan's first infiltration and expulsion (Book IV)
